svg.title: This is also the sum over leaves of their degree times their nearest internal parent’s exponent: each leaf’s path telescopes. Thus a direct output of degree m has rate E −maroot, and a tested remainder through degree m has rate E −(m+1)aroot. The price (NE1) has exactly this engineering rate plus ε P v ∆v. The latter is strictly positive after normalizing P v av = 1: at least one av > 0, and each av is at most the sum of the nonnegative advances along all vertices. Therefore it absorbs every fixed multiplicative constant, even when individual advances are zero.
